items.html:
Anil Mandal is a right-hand batsman who is part of Nepal's squad to the Under-19 World Cup in 2008. He took up cricket at the age of ten and admires Sachin Tendulkar. Mandal wants to be a businessman in the future.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
